text: I find myself in a place that feels both modern and contemplative—perhaps a museum or an innovation center. The sleek architecture and the colorful, thought-provoking display titled "R + D" suggest a space dedicated to advancement and creative inquiry. The blurred figure passing by reminds me of the ceaseless flow of time, while the glass, screens, and texts invite slow, curious reflection. I feel curious and slightly awed, reminded that knowledge is an ongoing process, unfolding around me and within me.
